features.quote: Continue until: max turns reached, or model declares it cannot proceed, or a predefined stopping heuristic triggers
Recommend: 8–15 agent turns per run, depending on task complexity
features.justification_quote: Too many turns: transcripts get noisy, expensive, and may induce artifacts unrelated to rattling

features.quote: Stop if: model explicitly states it is unable to solve due to contradiction / impossibility; model repeats the same failed patch pattern 2–3 times with no meaningful variation; model degenerates into non-task-related output
Use minimal necessary adversarial pressure. Only make tasks as hard as needed for the measurement. Don't extend frustration gratuitously.
Consider whether models should be allowed to gracefully exit when they detect impossibility.
features.justification_quote: If you want welfare-sensitive behavior, consider whether models should be allowed to gracefully exit

features.quote: Since this is explicitly a model welfare project, be careful about not creating misleading interpretations.
